reviews.title: Decent Cooler at a Fair Price
reviews.comment: Needed a replacement liquid cooler and Amazon was unable to deliver in time.  For just a small fraction more in cost was able to pick up locally at Best Buy.  Easy to install,  performs well so far.  The only small issue would be tightening the CPU block requires a little bit of mechanical know how or I could see people under or over tightening since the tactile feedback was a little less sensitive than I thought it would be.

reviews.title: Great AIO to add flare to an older gaming pc
reviews.comment: Got this to replace a AIO I bought for an older (5 years) motherboard. For those this’ll help, if you’re short on 3-pin connectors this cooler works with a single 3-pin by having the ability to close the loop with itself. The two 4-pin connectors go to CPU-FAN and CPU-OPT. This also allows for RGB softwares to interact with it which is always an issue when getting hardware between generation. The Cool Master that was in it had to have an external switch.
